outputs.explanation: Body weight, LW/BW, and FW/BW are shown as scatter plots with individual mouse data points (n=5 per group) overlaid with mean ± S.D. bars.
Panel B shows representative gross photographic images, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel C shows representative H&E and Oil Red O staining micrographs, not a quantitative plot.
Panel D shows dot blot and methylene blue staining images, not a graph of averaged values.
The 5mC/Methylene Blue quantification is shown as a bar graph with individual data points (n=5 per group) plotted on top of the bars along with mean ± S.D.
The TET1/TET2/TET3 quantification bar graph displays individual data points (n=6 NC, n=7 HFD) overlaid on the bars in addition to mean ± S.D.
